pixel_hash_note: sha1 over the decoded RGB buffer before any letterbox or resize. Exact: zero false positives by construction, and robust to re-encoding, which file-level sha1 is not. Run over all indexed images, not the clean subset.
verdict_rests_on: pixel SSIM and timestamp evidence, NOT Hamming distance. The hash proposes candidates; on line art over a uniform background it largely measures shape family, so a threshold borrowed from photographic work flags cards that look alike rather than cards that are the same.
scope: corpus-level: no arm, no protocol, identified by corpus_fingerprint
